groups.root_cause: The script writes info/exclude without first creating the info/ directory, so it fails when the git template didn't create that directory.
The isolated dirty check rebuilds a fresh index and re-hashes the working tree without the global clean filters, so files that depend on those filters (such as LFS files) show up as modified.
The late-injection test writes the poisoned config to the isolated private repository instead of the land clone, so it never tests the attack it claims to cover.
